summary: Tested Live Cooking Modal TTS bug fix. The fix for speech being cut off mid-sentence is working correctly. The orchestrator's onStopSpeaking callback now logs but does not cancel speech, confirmed by console output: '[LiveCooking] Orchestrator stop signal ignored (speech owned by user)'. All modal controls (Play, Next, Back, Close, Hands-Free) work correctly. Timer countdown displays and updates properly.

critical.issue: ElevenLabs API returning 520 errors - fallback to browser TTS working correctly

tts_bug_fix_verification.fix_description: Strict whitelist for cancelSpeech() - only explicit user actions can cancel speech
